# Fetching Forecasted data by month
```{r}
# data source
worksheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1l6PfnoampNQS1oJ-iSIGF9KJM8OBf34Hq3yoxd1WE2I"


# Read and transform
forecasts_df_clean <- read_sheet(worksheet_url, sheet = "Monthly Forecasted Quantities", skip = 4) %>% 
    pivot_longer(2:last_col(), names_to = "period", values_to = "value") %>% 
    mutate(period = my(period), type = "Forecast") %>% 
    arrange(product_name, period) 

forecasts_df_clean %>% view()
```

# Actual historical Consumption
```{r}
# Data source url, generated using dhis2 data visualizer (csv)
khis_data_url <- "https://hiskenya.dha.go.ke/api/analytics.csv?dimension=dx%3AhH9gmEmEhH4.to0Pssxkq4S%3BbGGT0F7iRxt.to0Pssxkq4S%3BJ6qnTev1LXw.to0Pssxkq4S%3BhXa1xyUMfTa.to0Pssxkq4S%3BqaBPR9wbWku.to0Pssxkq4S%3BAR7RhdC90IV.to0Pssxkq4S%3BzXbxl6y97mi.to0Pssxkq4S%3BMsS41X1GEFr.to0Pssxkq4S%3BXgJfT71Unkn.to0Pssxkq4S%3BAPbXNRovb5w.to0Pssxkq4S%3BAVDzuypqGt9.to0Pssxkq4S%3BtfPZ6sGgh4q.to0Pssxkq4S%3Bdl4JcBnxu0X.to0Pssxkq4S&dimension=ou%3AUSER_ORGUNIT&dimension=pe%3A202001%3B202002%3B202003%3B202004%3B202005%3B202006%3B202007%3B202008%3B202009%3B202010%3B202011%3B202012%3B202101%3B202102%3B202103%3B202104%3B202105%3B202106%3B202107%3B202108%3B202109%3B202110%3B202111%3B202112%3B202201%3B202202%3B202203%3B202204%3B202205%3B202206%3B202207%3B202208%3B202209%3B202210%3B202211%3B202212%3B202301%3B202302%3B202303%3B202304%3B202305%3B202306%3B202307%3B202308%3B202309%3B202310%3B202311%3B202312%3B202401%3B202402%3B202403%3B202404%3B202405%3B202406%3B202407%3B202408%3B202409%3B202410%3B202411%3B202412%3B202501%3B202502%3B202503%3B202504%3B202505%3B202506%3B202507%3B202508%3B202509%3B202510%3B202511%3B202512%3B202601%3B202602%3B202603%3B202604%3B202605%3B202606&showHierarchy=false&hierarchyMeta=false&includeMetadataDetails=true&includeNumDen=false&skipRounding=false&completedOnly=false&outputIdScheme=NAME"

# dhis2 login credentials
auth <- authenticate(Sys.getenv("DHIS2_USERNAME"), Sys.getenv("DHIS2_PASSWORD"))

# fetch request from khis
khis_response <- GET(khis_data_url, auth, config=list(timeout=600))

# Unnesting from the returned binary format
actual_historical_consumption_df <- khis_response %>% 
    content(.) %>% 
    rawToChar(.) %>% 
    read.csv(text = .)

# Transforming to desired formt
actual_historical_consumption_clean_df <- actual_historical_consumption_df %>% 
    clean_names() %>%
    rename(analytic = data, org_unit = organisation_unit) %>% 
    select(analytic, period, value) |>
    mutate(period = period |> my(), type = "Actual Consumption") %>% 
    standardize_dhis_dx_names() %>% 
    arrange(analytic, period) %>% 
    filter(period >= "2020-07-01") %>% 
    rename(product_name = analytic)
```

```{r}
  ) |>

```

# Forecast Accuracy Dataframe
```{r}
fa_df_raw <- read_sheet(worksheet_url, sheet = "Forecasts April 2023 to 2024 per product", skip = 2)
  
fa_df_raw |>   
    # remove empty rows
    remove_empty(which = "rows") |> 
    # format the period column to date type
    mutate(Period = ymd(Period)) |> 
    pivot_longer(3:9, names_to = "method", values_to = "value") |> 
    # standardize column names
    clean_names() |>
    # Save copy to disk
    write_csv("data/forecasted_vs_actual_values_per_method.csv")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr) 
library(tidyr)
library(echarts4r)
library(htmlwidgets) 

# 1) Define a named color map (edit these names to match your real method names) 
method_color_map <- c( 
    actual_consumption = "#4E79A7", # blue 
    consumption_lmis = "#F28E2B", # orange
    service_ai = "#59A14F", # green 
    consumption_ai = "#E15759", # red 
    demographic = "#B07AA1", # purple 
    service_excel = "#9C755F", # brown 
    consumption_excel = "pink" ) 

# 2) Prepare data first (so we can control series order + colors) 
df_plot <- fa_df_clean |> 
    pivot_longer( cols = actual_consumption:consumption_lmis, names_to = "method", values_to = "value" ) |>
    filter(product == "DMPA-IM", forecast_type == "Main") |> 
    arrange(period) 

# Stable method order (appears in legend + determines color assignment order) 

method_order <- df_plot |> 
    distinct(method) |> 
    arrange(method) |> 
    pull(method) 

df_plot <- df_plot |> 
    mutate(method = factor(method, levels = method_order)) 

# Build palette in EXACT series order (unnamed vector for echarts4r) 
palette_in_order <- unname(method_color_map[method_order]) 
# If any methods weren't defined in your map, give them a fallback color # (prevents NA colors causing unexpected behavior)

fallback <- c("#76B7B2", "#EDC948", "#FF9DA7", "#BAB0AC", "#1F77B4", "#2CA02C") 

na_idx <- which(is.na(palette_in_order)) 

if (length(na_idx) > 0) 
    { palette_in_order[na_idx] <- rep(fallback, length.out = length(na_idx)) } 

# 3) Plot 

df_plot |> 
    group_by(method) |> 
    e_charts_(x = "period") |> 
    e_line_( 
        serie = "value",
        smooth = T, 
        showSymbol = TRUE, 
        symbol = "circle",
        symbolSize = 6, 
        emphasis = list( focus = "series", scale = TRUE ) 
        ) |> 
    # IMPORTANT: e_color expects an ordered palette vector (not a named map) 
    e_color(palette_in_order) |> 
    e_title( 
        text = "Actual Vs Forecasts — Implanon",
        subtext = "Main forecast type • Hover to highlight • Zoom to inspect periods" ) |>
    e_axis_labels(x = "Date", y = NULL) |> 
    e_legend( 
        orient = "vertical", 
        right = 10, 
        top = "middle", 
        type = "scroll"
        ) |> 
    # remove grid lines
    e_x_axis(splitLine = list(show = FALSE)) |>
    e_y_axis(splitLine = list(show = FALSE)) |>
    # Tooltip: use param.value, which is usually [x, y] 
    e_tooltip( 
        trigger = "axis", 
        axisPointer = list(type = "line"),
        formatter = JS("
          function(params){
            if(!params || !params.length) return '';
            var d = new Date(params[0].axisValue);
            var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
    
            var s = '<b>' + dateStr + '</b><br/>';
            params.forEach(function(p){
              var v = p.value;
              if (Array.isArray(v)) v = v[1];
              var val = (v == null) ? '-' : Number(v).toLocaleString();
              s += p.marker + ' ' + p.seriesName + ': <b>' + val + '</b><br/>';
            });
            return s;
          }
        ")
        ) |>
    e_grid(left = 60, right = 200, top = 70, bottom = 60) |> 
    e_datazoom(type = "inside") |> 
    e_datazoom(type = "slider") |> 
    e_theme("roma") |>
    e_toolbox() |> 
    e_toolbox_feature("dataZoom") |>
    e_toolbox_feature("restore") |> 
    e_toolbox_feature("saveAsImage")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(apexcharter)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Color map (names must match the series names you create)
method_color_map <- c(
  actual_consumption = "#4E79A7",
  consumption_lmis   = "#F28E2B",
  service_ai         = "#59A14F",
  consumption_ai     = "#E15759",
  demographic        = "#B07AA1",
  service_excel      = "#9C755F",
  consumption_excel  = "pink"
)

# 1) Build a long dataset (robust: pivot only columns that exist)
method_cols <- intersect(names(method_color_map), names(fa_df_clean))
```


```{r}
df_long <- fa_df_clean |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = any_of(method_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "value"
  ) 

# max actual period
actual_period_max <- df_long |> 
    filter(!is.na(value), method == "actual_consumption", ) |>
    filter(period == max(period)) |> 
    distinct(period) |> 
    pull(period)

df_long_filtered <- df_long |> 
  filter(product == "DMPA-IM", forecast_type == "Main", period <= actual_period_max) |>
  arrange(period) |>
  mutate(
    # Force story order: Actual first, then the rest
    method = factor(method, levels = c("actual_consumption", setdiff(sort(unique(method)), "actual_consumption")))
  )

series_levels <- levels(df_long_filtered$method)
n_series <- length(series_levels)

# 2) Style vectors: Actual (index 1) thick+solid; Forecasts dashed+thin
stroke_width <- c(4, rep(2, max(0, n_series - 1)))
dash_array   <- c(0, rep(6, max(0, n_series - 1)))    # 0 = solid, 6 = dashed spacing
marker_size  <- c(3, rep(5, max(0, n_series - 1)))

# 3) Build the chart
apex(
  data = df_long_filtered,
  type = "spline",
  mapping = aes(x = period, y = value, group = method)
) %>%
  # Exact colors by series name
  ax_colors_manual(as.list(method_color_map)) %>%

  # Actual vs Forecast styling
  ax_stroke(width = stroke_width, dashArray = dash_array) %>%
  ax_markers(size = 5) %>%

  # Legend on the right
  ax_legend(position = "bottom") %>%

  # Remove grid lines (both x & y)
  ax_grid(
    xaxis = list(lines = list(show = FALSE)),
    yaxis = list(lines = list(show = FALSE))
  ) %>%

  # Remove y-axis title
  ax_yaxis(
      title = list(text = ""),
      labels = list(
      formatter = JS("
        function (val) {
          return val.toLocaleString();
        }
      ")
    )
    ) %>%

  # Tooltip: shared across series + nicely formatted numbers
  ax_tooltip(
    shared = TRUE,
    y = list(formatter = format_num(","))
  ) %>%

  # Titles
  ax_title("Actual Vs Forecasts — Implanon") %>%
  ax_subtitle("Actual = thick solid • Forecasts = thin dashed • Hover to compare methods")

```



# function 
```{r}

generate_forecast_accuracy_chart <- function(data, product_name, forecast_series_type) {
    # Color map (names must match the series names you create)
    method_color_map <- c(
      actual_consumption = "#4E79A7",
      consumption_lmis   = "#F28E2B",
      service_ai         = "#59A14≥F",
      consumption_ai     = "#E15759",
      demographic        = "#B07AA1",
      service_excel      = "#9C755F",
      consumption_excel  = "pink"
    )
    
    series_levels <- levels(data$method)
    n_series <- length(series_levels)
    
    # 2) Style vectors: Actual (index 1) thick+solid; Forecasts dashed+thin
    stroke_width <- c(4, rep(2, max(0, n_series - 1)))
    dash_array   <- c(0, rep(6, max(0, n_series - 1)))    # 0 = solid, 6 = dashed spacing
    marker_size  <- c(3, rep(5, max(0, n_series - 1)))
    
    # 3) Build the chart
    apex(
      data = data,
      type = "spline",
      mapping = aes(x = period, y = value, group = method)
    ) %>%
      # Exact colors by series name
      ax_colors_manual(as.list(method_color_map)) %>%
    
      # Actual vs Forecast styling
      ax_stroke(width = stroke_width, dashArray = dash_array) %>%
      ax_markers(size = 5) %>%
    
      # Legend on the right
      ax_legend(position = "bottom") %>%
    
      # Remove grid lines (both x & y)
      ax_grid(
        xaxis = list(lines = list(show = FALSE)),
        yaxis = list(lines = list(show = FALSE))
      ) %>%
    
      # Remove y-axis title
      ax_yaxis(
          title = list(text = ""),
          labels = list(
          formatter = JS("
            function (val) {
              return val.toLocaleString();
            }
          ")
        )
        ) %>%
    
      # Tooltip: shared across series + nicely formatted numbers
      ax_tooltip(
        shared = TRUE,
        y = list(formatter = format_num(","))
      ) %>%
    
      # Titles
      ax_title("Actual Vs Forecasts — Implanon") %>%
      ax_subtitle("Actual = thick solid • Forecasts = thin dashed • Hover to compare methods")
}
```
